changes.zh: 遣翰率騎擊之，渾大敗，僅以身免，盡俘其眾。
changes.before: Murong Han shattered his army and took nearly every man alive.
changes.after: He sent Murong Han with cavalry to strike them; Moqian Hun was badly defeated and escaped alone, while his entire host was taken captive.
changes.reason: English omits 遣翰率騎擊之 (Huang sent Han with cavalry), 僅以身免 (escaped alone with only his person), and names neither the dispatch nor Hun’s lone flight.
